'''Carol Jacobanis''' is an American voice actress for the English [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is currently affiliated with Stewart Talent Agency.

== Pokémon roles ==
Jacobanis began to provide voices for Pokémon in [[S03|the third season]] until [[HS01]].
